MUSIC AND DANCE — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   C. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.

2. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.
   D. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.

3. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

10. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   B. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   C. Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)

13. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Instruments.
   B. Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Western Instruments.

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

15. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Instrumental Transpositions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Four-Part Harmony and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
